name: BlazeNet
summary: Melbourne dialup ISP (reboot of Doctor Blaze BBS), a registered business name of Artel Computer Pty Ltd; folded into Hotkey Internet Services c. 2001 (ARTEL COMPUTER PTY LTD, ACN 005 884 980).

events.details: Reboot of Doctor Blaze BBS; a registered business name owned by Artel Computer Pty Ltd (ACN 005 884 980), P.O. Box 77, Kerrimuir VIC 3129.
Folded into Hotkey Internet Services; last independent homepage Jan 2001, redirect by Mar 2002.
BLAZENET PTY LTD (ACN 630 398 195) was registered 04 Dec 2018, ~17 years after this ISP folded, and is an unrelated later name-collision entity, not the operator of blaze.net.au.

refs.label: ABR: BLAZENET PTY LTD ACN 630 398 195 (registered 2018; unrelated later entity, not the ISP operator)
